UpdateLog.description:
<title>Notes</title><font>Small</font> Quick patch for unstable build.
If you are a modder, there is a <link>https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ZxrrevFj6pPA4HgRmi3I8GZZcmbo4nHwXECTqfR9acE</link>(google doc) with a list of all relevant changes you'll need to look out for. <title>Bug Fixes</title><font>Tiny</font> - AerialVehicles destroy inner vehicle upon landing. - Various targeters were only configured to target surface layer tiles. - Crash landing event for aerial vehicles didn't trigger properly. - Map generation issue with aerial vehicles entering maps. - Vehicle spawn event would double register overlays to the new parallel renderer. - Crashed aerial vehicles would not tilt correctly post-spawn. - Aerial vehicles would land and enter wrong idle job. <title>Final Notes</title><font>Tiny</font> Please report any issues you find on either <link>https://discord.gg/zXDyfWQ</link>(discord) or <link>https://github.com/SmashPhil/Vehicle-Framework/issues</link>(github).
